title: The same standards, on every commission.
text: Whether the client is a hotel group, a designer or a household, the job runs the same way. These are the parts a photograph never shows.

items.title: Survey and scope, room by room
items.text: We measure the wall that will actually be hung, allow for the repeat and the wastage, and write a scope of works room by room before anyone orders paper.

items.title: Preparation decides the finish
items.text: Walls are filled, made good and primed until they are true. If a wall is not ready for the material specified, we say so before the last drop is ordered.

items.title: Protection and containment
items.text: Floors, furniture and finished joinery are protected as part of the hang. Work is contained and the place is left tidy each evening. In a home we are visitors; in a hotel we work around the house.

items.title: Batch and shade control
items.text: Deliveries are checked against the measure, and batches and shading are managed so that a corridor of rooms reads as one surface.

items.title: Set out from the room's focal points
items.text: Pattern is set out from chimneypieces, doorcases and bed walls, so the design meets the cornice and the joinery with composure.

items.title: One team, then the return visit
items.text: The people who start are the people who finish. Four to six weeks after completion we come back to look at every seam and edge, and the workmanship is guaranteed for twelve months.
